abstract: Rendezvous means a meeting at an agreed time and place. Randevoo is an online reservation platform via mobile application. It connects customers to sellers throughout specific reservations and offers customers fully comprehensive products' specifications and locations. Problems: price is the most essential concern for every customer buying the online products, precision is another factor that most customers desire as their expectation, and no easy way exists to reserve reservations with multiple stores via a single service. Solutions: a mobile platform where customers can reserve reservations at nearby stores to save money when exploring and comparing, save time when found as expected and as desired, and have exclusivity when reserving to the store. The system has an iOS app for customers and business owners (business accounts, business hours that auto-generate reservation schedules, product listings, reservation approve or decline, QR code check-in) and a React web app for administration to monitor the service, manage products, and manage users and stores, backed by Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, and Cloud Messaging, with Algolia product search and Google Maps store locations and navigation.

abstract: Our Senior project is the Hotel Management System. The main operations that we focused on reservation system in hotel service. In the current trends, there are many hotels that change from traditional operation to digital-based operation which significantly help the hotel to gather information and learn customer behavior, and one of the digital platforms is the website platform which provides various optional systems. So, we have decided to adapt the hotel management system in a web-based platform in order to increase hotel performance, using iPower Hotel Chiang Rai as the case study. On the customer side, the program provides a reservation system for the hotel, a gallery system for the hotel, and an infographic for the hotel, so customers do not need to use mobile phone or walk-in to directly contact the hotel but can book room via the website. On the admin side, the program provides an admin managing customers' account system for the hotel and an admin supervision on customers and reservation system, to inspect customers' activity, gather data and payment information, and ban bad behaviour customers that spam the reservation system.

abstract: This senior project is basically based on Dental Inventory Management System (DIMS), a system built to manage the inventory system in the dental clinic. The dental inventory management system is essentially built to organize, perform, and track inventory in the clinic such as tools and equipment. The statement of problem lists lack of storage, security issues, document transportation, prone to damage, and limit communication and collaboration. The main objective of this project is to make it easy for the clinic to manage and interact with the inventory system, to allow clinic staff to check the available stocks of items, tools, and equipment, and to replace the traditional paper-based system.
